rules.title: Build fails or an API is unavailable
rules.symptom: A selected target does not compile, launch, or offer the expected API.
checks: Confirm Xcode, SDK, deployment target, and device OS versions for each selected platform.
Check API availability and conditional code at the call site; do not infer support from another Apple platform.
Reproduce on a supported Simulator and, for hardware-specific behavior, a physical device.

rules.title: A capability works in one build but fails after signing
rules.symptom: A device, TestFlight, or release build cannot use an expected capability.
checks: Compare the capability in the target, App ID, provisioning profile, and signed entitlements.
Check the failing build configuration and distribution environment rather than assuming debug settings carry over.
Save the exact entitlement error and the affected target before changing signing settings.

rules.title: Privacy declaration or App Review blocks release
rules.symptom: Archive validation or App Review reports missing disclosure, permission context, or required metadata.
checks: Inventory collected data, third-party SDKs, required-reason APIs, permission prompts, and in-app disclosures.
Check the built app and included SDK privacy manifests against the actual behavior.
Reproduce the reviewer path and include working credentials or demo access when review requires an account.

rules.title: A screen breaks with larger text or another language
rules.symptom: Content clips, controls lose labels, or a flow becomes difficult to complete.
checks: Preview representative content at large text sizes, increased contrast, and Reduce Motion settings.
Test longer translated strings and right-to-left layout where applicable.
Verify every critical action with the platform's accessibility input and focus model.

rules.title: Liquid Glass is hard to read or feels overused
rules.symptom: Navigation or controls lose contrast, overlap content, or look inconsistent across OS versions and appearances.
checks: Check whether standard navigation and controls already provide the correct system glass before adding a custom effect.
Keep glass in the functional layer; remove decorative glass from content cards and reduce stacked blur or tint.
Compare light and dark, increased contrast, reduced transparency, Reduce Motion, changing content, and earlier-OS fallback on selected devices.

rules.title: The app is smooth on one device but slow or hot on another
rules.symptom: Launch, scrolling, a main action, memory, or energy use regresses on a supported device class.
checks: Record the device, OS, release build, dataset, and exact journey; reproduce on representative physical hardware rather than relying on Simulator.
Compare cold and warm launch, response, hitches, memory, and energy with a baseline for the same scenario.
Profile the failing path with Xcode and Instruments; inspect broad view updates, main-thread work, images, and custom effects before changing the device support promise.

rules.title: iPhone layout clips or loses work when Duo opens or closes
rules.symptom: A compact screen becomes a larger scene or returns to compact space, and controls clip, navigation resets, or a draft disappears.
checks: Reproduce the same task on the outer and inner displays while recording scene size, size classes, and the transition; do not branch on a device model or global screen width.
Check that navigation and draft state live outside the layout switch and restore by stable item IDs for each scene.
Check safe areas, partial-fold posture, split view, larger text, and repeated transitions in the matching Duo Simulator; verify touch and performance on hardware before claiming support.

rules.title: Live Activity does not appear
rules.symptom: The app starts an activity, but the expected system presentation is absent.
checks: Check Activity authorization and the request error; confirm the activity is associated with an active event.
Verify the app and widget extension configuration, supported OS, and tested presentation surface.
Do not assume the Dynamic Island exists on every device or that the system displays an activity continuously.

rules.title: Live Activity shows old information
rules.symptom: The activity remains visible while its content stops reflecting the event.
checks: Check the activity state, stale date, update path, and last successful content update.
Test loss of network, app suspension, push delivery if used, and the end-of-event path.
Design a truthful stale and ended state instead of promising continuous refresh.

rules.title: iPhone activity does not look right on Apple Watch
rules.symptom: The paired Watch Smart Stack does not show the intended compact information.
checks: Confirm the Live Activity starts on its supported origin device and inspect the paired Watch presentation.
Review compact content for legibility and privacy on the Watch.
If a persistent Watch surface is needed, specify a separate WidgetKit widget or complication.

rules.title: Widget is missing or refreshes later than expected
rules.symptom: A widget has stale data, does not appear in the gallery, or misses a desired update time.
checks: Check widget family, kind, extension configuration, timeline entries, and placeholder/snapshot states.
Check shared data availability between app and extension.
Account for system-controlled reload budgets; use an activity for a bounded live event where appropriate.

rules.title: Purchase succeeds but access or restore fails
rules.symptom: A customer cannot unlock, restore, or retain the expected entitlement.
checks: Verify product identifiers, StoreKit configuration, sandbox account, and App Store Connect state.
Test purchase, cancellation, expiration, refund, interrupted purchase, and restore paths.
Inspect verified transactions and entitlement state on a second device before changing paywall copy.

rules.title: Data differs between devices
rules.symptom: Edits are delayed, missing, duplicated, or conflict across devices.
checks: Confirm account, iCloud availability, container, network state, and whether sync is enabled.
Reproduce offline edits and concurrent changes with two devices and record conflict resolution.
Keep local work usable during a sync delay and expose a recovery route for failed data transfer.

rules.title: Work stops when the app is backgrounded or locked
rules.symptom: Upload, transfer, recording, or scheduled work stops or finishes late.
checks: Identify the supported background API and the actual task type before adding a background mode.
Reproduce after lock, termination, low power, and poor network conditions on a physical device.
Make progress resumable and show the user when work is paused or requires reopening the app.

rules.title: Notification is not delivered or shown
rules.symptom: A scheduled or remote notification does not reach the expected user surface.
checks: Check authorization, device settings, Focus, delivery environment, and token or scheduling state.
Separate server acceptance from device delivery and presentation in diagnostics.
Test denied permission and in-app recovery without repeating a coercive prompt.

rules.title: Apple TV navigation traps focus
rules.symptom: Remote input cannot reach a control or return from a screen.
checks: Walk the full journey using only the remote and test initial focus, directional moves, and the back path.
Check focus order after loading, error, and empty-state changes.
Keep critical controls readable and reachable from a viewing distance.

rules.title: Vision Pro presentation is uncomfortable or misplaced
rules.symptom: A window or immersive element is difficult to read, target, or use comfortably.
checks: Review viewing distance, element size, contrast, and placement in an actual headset when possible.
Test eye and hand input, window resizing, and transitions between immersion levels.
Keep a usable windowed path when an immersive experience is optional.

rules.title: Paid app or IAP cannot be created or submitted
rules.symptom: App Store Connect blocks IAP creation or a paid submission before code is reviewed.
checks: Have the Account Holder confirm the latest Paid Apps Agreement was accepted before creating IAP.
For submission, confirm the agreement is Active and complete the required tax and banking information.
Inspect the agreement status and resolve Pending User Info or verification rather than changing StoreKit code.

rules.title: First purchase product is not reviewed
rules.symptom: An initial IAP remains unapproved although the app version was submitted.
checks: Identify whether this is the first IAP of its type for the app.
Attach the first item of that type to a new app-version submission.
After one item of that type is approved, check the separate-submission path for later items.

rules.title: App Store submission rejects a beta toolchain build
rules.symptom: A build used in TestFlight cannot be submitted to the App Store.
checks: Record the exact Xcode and SDK build used for the archive.
Check the current App Store Connect release notes for App Store eligible release or RC builds and current SDK minimums.
Use the allowed internal or external TestFlight path for beta builds while producing a separate eligible App Store archive.

rules.title: Access is wrong after renewal or refund
rules.symptom: A subscriber gains or loses access incorrectly during grace, expiry, or revocation.
checks: Inspect verified current entitlements and transaction updates at launch and after the event.
Distinguish a disabled auto-renewal from expiration, billing grace, and a refunded or revoked transaction.
Reproduce the chosen grace policy in StoreKit Test before relying on a device-clock calculation.

rules.title: App disappears from EU storefronts
rules.symptom: An intended EU listing is unavailable despite an approved app.
checks: Check the app's EU territory availability in App Store Connect.
Confirm the developer's DSA trader status was submitted and verified.
Resolve an unverified trader status before investigating a binary or search-index issue.
